summary: Braskem S.A., a Brazilian petrochemical company, filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of its Board of Directors meeting held June 8, 2026. The Board elected Magda Maria de Regina Chambriard as Chairperson and Hélio Baptista Novaes as Vice-Chairperson for a two-year term. Additionally, the Board approved the early termination of current statutory officers and elected new ones: Helcio Tokeshi as CEO, Carlos Augusto Machado Pereira de Almeida Brandão as CFO and IRO, and Luiz Gustavo Perrotti Rossato as an officer, nominated by shareholder FIP. No financial terms or transaction details were disclosed. The filing reflects routine governance changes under the shareholders' agreement between FIP and Petrobras. Watch for any future strategic shifts under new leadership.
